method: CSS local font stacks only; no font files, @font-face declarations, external font CSS or font data URLs in app.

systemFonts.conclusion: Retain local references. These names do not grant redistribution or web embedding rights; the installed version and its license govern. Apple bundled display permission is license-specific; Windows CSS-name permission is explicit.

openFonts.commercialUse: Allowed subject to OFL conditions; preserve notices if distributing and respect reserved names. No font binaries currently distributed.

brandGraphics: Existing wordmarks are graphic assets, separately confirmed self-created or authorized by the operator. Their typeface provenance is not established by CSS inspection.

excludedCandidates.reason: The standalone Apple download license sections 2A and 2B restrict use to specified Apple-platform interface mockups and restrict website content. Removed the explicit family-name candidate; it is not covered by a blanket free commercial-use conclusion. This does not determine whether any earlier operating-system-provided rendering infringed.
excludedCandidates.action: Removed explicit SF Mono from CSS font stack. No font was installed or executed.
